description_en: Retrieves the list of cross-region aggregated resources under the current account
description_zh: 获取当前账号下跨地域聚合的资源列表信息
name: ListDiscoveredResources

parameters.help_en:
The resource status. Valid values:

0: Deleted. If you have deleted a resource in the target cloud service, the resource is displayed as Deleted in the Cloud Config resources.
1 (default): Retained. If your resource is managed in a Normal state, the resource is displayed as Retained in the Cloud Config resources
parameters.help_zh:
资源状态。取值：

0：已删除。如果您已在目标云产品中删除某个资源，则在配置审计的资源列表中显示该资源为已删除。
1（默认值）：保有中。如果您的资源被正常管理，则在配置审计的资源列表中显示该资源为保有中
parameters.name: resource_deleted

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for a single request. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The resource types. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The region IDs of resource ownership. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属的地域ID。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: regions

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. When the returned results of a request are truncated, you can use NextToken to initiate another request and obtain the remaining results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the time range for querying resources. The time is a standard UTC timestamp. Limits:
The value must be a timestamp in milliseconds.
The value cannot be greater than EndUpdateTimestamp, and the interval between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 30 days.
StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp must be both specified or both left empty
parameters.help_zh:
资源时间范围查询的开始时间，采用标准UTC时间戳。取值限制：
必须是毫秒时间戳。
不能大于EndUpdateTimestamp，且与EndUpdateTimestamp间隔范围小于等于30天。
StartUpdateTimestamp与EndUpdateTimestamp必须同时填写或同时不填写
parameters.name: start_update_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the time range for querying resources. The time is a standard UTC timestamp. Limits:
The value must be a timestamp in milliseconds.
The value cannot be less than StartUpdateTimestamp, and the interval between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 30 days.
StartUpdateTimestamp and EndUpdateTimestamp must be both specified or both left empty
parameters.help_zh:
资源时间范围查询的截止时间，采用标准UTC时间戳。取值限制：
必须是毫秒时间戳。
不能小于StartUpdateTimestamp，且与StartUpdateTimestamp间隔范围小于等于30天。
StartUpdateTimestamp与EndUpdateTimestamp必须同时填写或同时不填写
parameters.name: end_update_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The resource types to exclude. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,). If this parameter conflicts with the ResourceTypes parameter, this parameter takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 排除的资源类型，多资源类型用逗号分隔，与ResourceTypes字段冲突时，该字段具有更高优先级
parameters.name: exclude_resource_types

AccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the resource owner
AccountId.description_zh: 资源拥有者的阿里云账号ID

ResourceCreationTime.description_en: The timestamp when the resource was created. Unit: milliseconds
ResourceCreationTime.description_zh: 资源创建时间戳。单位：毫秒

ResourceDeleted.description_en:
The resource status. Valid values:
0: Deleted.
1: Retained
ResourceDeleted.description_zh:
资源状态。取值：
0：已删除。
1：保有中

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the resource belongs. Example: rg-acfmvoh45rhxxxx
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 资源所属的资源组ID，例如：rg-acfmvoh45rhxxxx
ResourceGroupId.title_en: 资源所属的资源组ID，例如：rg-acfmvoh45rhxxxx
ResourceGroupId.title_zh: 资源所属的资源组ID，例如：rg-acfmvoh45rhxxxx

ResourceStatus.description_en:
The resource status. The status of a resource depends on the definition of the cloud service to which the resource belongs. This parameter may be empty. Examples:
If the resource type is ACS::ECS::Instance, this parameter is Running or Stopped because ECS instances have statuses.
If the resource type is ACS::OSS::Bucket, this parameter is empty because OSS buckets do not have statuses
ResourceStatus.description_zh:
资源状态。资源的状态取决于各云服务对其的定义，该参数可能为空。例如：
当资源类型为ACS::ECS::Instance时，由于ECS实例有状态，因此该参数为Running或Stopped。
当资源类型为ACS::OSS::Bucket时，由于OSS Bucket无状态，因此该参数为空

UpdateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the resource was last updated. Unit: milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 资源的最近一次更新时间，毫秒级时间戳

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the resource belongs. Format: vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx. If multiple values exist, they are separated by commas (,), such as vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx,vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx. If the resource does not belong to a vSwitch, an empty string "" is returned
VSwitchId.description_zh: 所属的 vSwitch ID，格式：vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，多值时逗号分隔，如 vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，无所属VSWITCH时返回为空字符串：""
VSwitchId.title_en: 所属的 vSwitch ID，格式：vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，多值时逗号分隔，如 vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，无所属VSWITCH时返回为空字符串：""
VSwitchId.title_zh: 所属的 vSwitch ID，格式：vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，多值时逗号分隔，如 vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，vsw-t4n7pokxxxxxxxxxxxxxx，无所属VSWITCH时返回为空字符串：""

Version.description_en: The version of the resource change

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the resource belongs. Format: vpc-t4nhheyvay74fp7n0hxxx. If the resource does not belong to a VPC, an empty string "" is returned
VpcId.description_zh: 所属的 vpc ID，格式：vpc-t4nhheyvay74fp7n0hxxx，无所属VPC时返回空字符串: ""
VpcId.title_en: 所属的 vpc ID，格式：vpc-t4nhheyvay74fp7n0hxxx，无所属VPC时返回空字符串: ""
VpcId.title_zh: 所属的 vpc ID，格式：vpc-t4nhheyvay74fp7n0hxxx，无所属VPC时返回空字符串: ""

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en: The token used to query the next page
